aws.title: Amazon & AWS Integration Architecture
aws.subtitle: Where each Amazon capability is implemented in GreenCode. Live status is read from the running backend.
aws.summaryDesc: GreenCode integrates Amazon Alexa+ (via the Model Context Protocol / MCP) with Amazon Bedrock (Claude 3.5 Sonnet) and AWS regional telemetry for voice-driven code auditing, verified AST refactoring, and cloud carbon comparison.
aws.flowStep1Desc: Developer asks Alexa ("Alexa, ask GreenCode to audit our repository")
aws.flowStep2Desc: Alexa invokes /mcp tool audit_and_score over RFC 9728 secure transport
aws.flowStep3Desc: Claude 3.5 Sonnet analyzes AST nodes and synthesizes verified O(N) patch
aws.flowStep4Desc: Telemetry shifts batch jobs to cleanest AWS datacenter (e.g., Ireland eu-west-1)
aws.flowStep5Desc: Alexa vocalizes the green score, kWh saved, and opens GitHub Pull Request
